purpose: Test whether a dimensionless baryonic potential-path ratio can correct P0683's wrong within-cluster ordering while retaining its galaxy/cluster onset, Solar screening, universal settings, and single QUMOND-style field equation.
formula_generator: P0683 post-result audit only; Spearman rho=-0.90 across five non-boundary spent clusters is hypothesis-generating and not validation

equation.primary_interpretation: one local channel plus three spatial channels whose coherent amplitude survives as the inverse square root of the number of local radial-acceleration lengths stored in the baryonic potential

diagnostic_sensitivity_grid.selection_role: response mapping only; only N_extra=3, n=2, q=1/2 can advance

spent_galaxy_test.potential_and_path_closure: integrate each measured outer baryonic profile to its last radius and close with a point-mass tail
spent_galaxy_test.claim_limit: spent development transfer under an existing nuisance solution, not full disk QUMOND or new-galaxy validation

spent_cluster_test.target: mean baryonic reduced deflection plus mean radial compact-halo deflection in each P0682 annular bin
spent_cluster_test.prediction: spherical line-of-sight deflection at reference source redshift z=2
spent_cluster_test.claim_limit: spent low-parameter comparator target, not a unique physical halo map

solar_proxy.warning: force screening is not a covariant PPN or Cassini-gamma derivation

selection_rule: Among only N_extra=3, n=2, q=1/2 rows that pass the galaxy and Solar gates, select chi_t with the lowest all-five-cluster log RMS; ties within 1e-6 dex choose larger chi_t. Advance to registered 3D QUMOND only if every frozen gate passes. No diagnostic row may be promoted post hoc.
claim_boundary: The inverse-square-root path survival is a proposed vector-coherence interpretation, not derived quantum gravity.
The post-result five-cluster correlation generated this equation and cannot validate it.
The Newtonian potential and eta closures must be replaced or justified covariantly if the phenomenology survives.
The photon response remains a zero-slip working assumption without a relativistic action.
No image multiplicity, parity, critical curve, positional likelihood, or sealed target is evaluated.
